text:
hana.pm: Morning team  excited to start today! Quick asks: I can't open the FigJam for the kickoff workshop and I don't have the 'Design Tokens' Figma file. Also need Product Roadmap Notion access. Who do I ping?

mike.designops: welcome @hana :wave: I'll sort Figma/FIGJAM access. Which email are you using? Also, are you on SSO or invited via email?

hana.pm: hana@redwood.com via SSO. When I click the FigJam link it redirects to the SSO sign-in loop.

sso-bot: Detected SSO sign-in loop for hana@redwood.com. Please re-initiate SSO login from https://login.redwood.com and confirm after. If problem persists, file in #eng-requests with subject `SSO: figma`.

ritu.design: Hi @hana! For design tokens we're moving to a new file called "Tokens 123" under the Design org. Mike can add you to the team. Also FigJam is for Fri's workshop (sticky notes + journey mapping) so you'll want access before then.

hana.pm: re-logged in via the SSO link, still seeing the loop. Filing in #eng-requests now.

mike.designops: pinged infra in #eng-requests and also added a request to invite you directly.

ellie.research: @hana welcome! Research folder access: Product > Research > Studies. I'll add you to the Checkout study and drop a short onboarding doc with recent syntheses. We also keep recruiting info in the Drive folder.

legal-bot: Reminder: any user research involving external participants requires an approved consent template. For Checkout studies use Template v3 (Notion: Research > Templates). Contact legal@redwood.com for expedited review.

hana.pm: thanks Ellie and legal-bot. mike, any ETA on Figma/Token access?

mike.designops: infra acknowledged the ticket, usually 2-4 hours. Meanwhile I shared a view-only link to the Tokens file and the FigJam as a temporary measure. You should have a notification shortly.

hana.pm: I see the view links, can confirm. One more Q: where is the Product Roadmap Q3 doc? I searched Notion but got multiple pages.

ellie.research: Notion path is Product > Roadmap > Q3 Planning (we keep the TL;DR at the top). I'll DM a direct link to you. Also FYI we synth'd past Checkout user flows in the Research > Checkout > Synth folder.

hana.pm: perfect, got the Notion link and the view-only Figma. Thanks everyone! I'll update if the SSO ticket isn't resolved.

mike.designops: great. If SSO still blocks you after infra work, reply here and I'll escalate to identity engineering. Also adding you to Tue crit invite and the Checkout channel.

hana.pm: awesome, appreciate it :sparkles:
